_comment: Every generator tool is a sibling ../* checkout of an ASCS-eV fork, on the feature/asam-pipeline branch, rebased on the recorded upstream development branch with only the recorded carried_commits cherry-picked on top. Updating this file is a release-like action: rebase/cherry-pick, re-verify carried_commits, regenerate both standards, and review the artifact diff in the same change. See pipeline/README.md for the procedure and for what each fork's carried commits are for.

carried_commits.subject: test: reorder the model export references the sortedOutput fix affects
fix(owl): declare a data property when the value type is an enumeration
feat(owl): let a union's alternatives be its association ends only

build.fingerprint_inputs: shapechange-core/target/classes (recursively) plus every jar resolved by `mvn -pl shapechange-core dependency:build-classpath`; each file's own SHA-256, sorted by filename, concatenated as '{filename}:{hash}\n', then SHA-256 of the concatenation

carried_commits.subject: feat: add owl:onDataRange simple cardinality rules (data-property counterpart of owl:onClass)
test: add offline verification and the object-property maximum control
fix: guard the qualified onDataRange rules in the open and original rulesets
refactor: limit the change to the three documented flavors, cross-check with the CLI
fix: decide datatype ranges structurally, and map owl:oneOf to sh:in
feat(owl2shacl): allow the conversion rules to be supplied explicitly
fix(app): fail on an input that cannot be read instead of producing an empty result
fix(owl2shacl): gather sh:ignoredProperties into an RDF list
fix(build): pin the xls2rdf dependency instead of tracking master
carried_commits.note: Not yet submitted upstream. Required for jar_fingerprint to mean anything: shacl-play-app bundles com.github.sparna-git.xls2rdf:xls2rdf-lib into its onejar, and version-managing it as master-SNAPSHOT let Maven's daily update policy swap 162 bundled entries with no change in any repository, so the same commit built on two days produced different binaries.

build.fingerprint_note: the onejar's raw file SHA-256 is NOT reproducible across clean builds: the plugin embeds per-entry ZIP timestamps. Verified across three independent clean `mvn clean install` runs: three different raw file hashes, one stable content fingerprint. The content fingerprint is computed by opening the jar as a zip, taking every non-directory entry, SHA-256 of its decompressed bytes, sorted by entry name, concatenated as '{name}:{hash}\n', then SHA-256 of the concatenation. Never lock or compare the raw file hash.

serialization._comment: Released Python distributions, not sibling forks. Exact versions from scripts/requirements.txt.

build_environment._maven_archive_comment: Keyed by archive filename because the two published archives of the same release have different checksums, and an unqualified value cannot say which one it verifies. On Linux you fetch the .tar.gz. Both values are Apache's published ones from archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.9/binaries/.

build_inputs._comment: Content-based fingerprints, verified identical across two independent clean `mvn clean install` rebuilds of the locked commits above, using the exact algorithm implemented in scripts/generate_semantic_artifacts.py (shapechange_runtime_fingerprint, zip_content_fingerprint). Update only after reproducing a new value across two independent clean builds in the environment recorded in build_environment. These values are environment-specific by nature: the same source compiled by JDK 21.0.11 and by 21.0.12 produces different fingerprints, which is what build_environment exists to pin. A value that will not reproduce is a defect to diagnose, not a number to overwrite - a fingerprint is only worth recording once every input it covers is itself pinned.
